pr_comments:
Parking this as it is of low priority and the naming issue probably raises more trouble than it is worth.

The functionality may also have little usage if the "unnest_all" type behaviour exists in the future.

issue_context.title: Rename struct fields with a prefix/suffix
issue_context.body:
### Problem description

This would be nice to do without having to manually pull out the fields; and allows unnesting the struct with some indication of the "namespace".
comments: I agree. I would accept a PR that enables this under `struct.suffix/ struct.prefix`.

As mentioned in https://github.com/pola-rs/polars/pull/12281#pullrequestreview-1717106373:

As we have recently centered all renaming functionality under the `name` namespace, I think renaming struct fields should also fall under this namespace.

Perhaps `.name.struct_prefix` / `.name_struct_suffix` ? Or perhaps `.name.prefix_fields` / `.name.suffix_fields` ?

@stinodego according to your suggestion, shouldn't https://pola-rs.github.io/polars/py-polars/html/reference/expressions/api/polars.Expr.struct.rename_fields.html this also be moved out of the struct?

Fair point.

@alexander-beedie do you have a suggestion on how to handle this in a manner that is consistent with the `name` namespace?

Hmm yeah, that's a little awkward.

The main usage of `.struct.prefix` seems to be as a building block for  "unnest_all" / "pd.json_normalize" type behaviour.

Perhaps if something more along those lines existed, there would be little use for this.

The suffixing could then probably be done at the `.col()` level after unnesting if needed.
